entity.name: `Promise.allSettled()`
entity.description: Returns a single Promise that fulfills when all of the input's promises fulfills.
entity.descriptionHtml: Returns a single Promise that fulfills when all of the input's promises fulfills.
entity.descriptionClean: Returns a single Promise that fulfills when all of the input's promises fulfills.

example.codeHighlighted: const promises = [promise1, promise2]; Promise.allSettled(promises).then((results) => results.forEach((result) => console.log(result.status)), );

webFeature.description_html: The Promise.allSettled() static method waits for an array of promises to settle (resolve or reject).
webFeature.name: Promise.allSettled()

entity.name: `Promise.any()`
entity.description: Returns a single Promise that fulfills when any of the input's promises fulfills.
entity.descriptionHtml: Returns a single Promise that fulfills when any of the input's promises fulfills.
entity.descriptionClean: Returns a single Promise that fulfills when any of the input's promises fulfills.

example.code:
const promises = [promise1, promise2, promise3];

Promise.any(promises).then((value) => console.log(value));
example.codeHighlighted: const promises = [promise1, promise2, promise3]; Promise.any(promises).then((value) => console.log(value));

webFeature.description_html: The Promise.any() static method returns a promise that fulfills as soon as the first of an iterable of promises fulfills, with that promise's value. Otherwise, it rejects with an AggregateError when all of the promises have rejected.
webFeature.name: Promise.any()

entity.name: `Promise.try()`
entity.description: Take a callback of any kind and wrap its result in a Promise.
entity.descriptionHtml: Take a callback of any kind and wrap its result in a Promise.
entity.descriptionClean: Take a callback of any kind and wrap its result in a Promise.

example.codeHighlighted: function doSomething(action) { return Promise.try(action) .then((result) => console.log(result)) .catch((error) => console.error(error)) .finally(() => console.log("Done")); }

webFeature.description_html: The Promise.try() static method returns a promise that takes a callback of any kind (returns or throws, synchronously or asynchronously) and wraps its result in a Promise.
webFeature.name: Promise.try()
